doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: De De's first records and the Paul Barnes broadcast
summary: De De cannot recall his first record and says Paul Barnes did radio broadcasts from Lake Charles.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: Now which are your first records, Dee Dee? What's your first one?
I forgot my number. I forgot my number.
I forgot my number. I ain't got any number. I forgot my number. I forgot my number.
I know we never made a record, we did broadcast. He did broadcast. Out of Lake Charles, K-L-P-C, I think something like that, Lake Charles.
And did they cut any records there in the studio? No, I see.
I don't know if it's just about the first record or not.
Who was the piano player with Paul Barnes on the time? He wasn't. He wasn't.
